manifest.noise: Synthetic Rician magnitude: hypot(x+n1,n2); independent Gaussian components; no clipping

normalization.note: Course fixed scale, not a claim that MINC real intensity spans 0..4095.

verification.terms: Public download with requested citations; no explicit redistribution license established. Obtain data directly; do not bundle volumes.
verification.reference_limitation: Public T1 images are fixed reference signals, not demonstrated noise-free anatomy. MINC history refers to pn3_rf20 coil settings. Metrics quantify recovery of these references after added Gaussian noise, not clinical effectiveness or removal of native artifacts.

subjects.conversion: MINC real scaling; float32; clip [0,4095]; divide by 4095
